data.admission_steps:
The complete admission process for the NMIMS online executive MBA involves below listed steps:

Step 1. Registration: Visit the official website of NMIMS CDOE and register.

Step 2. Application Form: Fill out the application form and pay the required application fee along with it.

Step 3. Document Submission: Attach the supporting documents along with the application form, including photo identity, academic transcript, passport size photograph, etc.

Step 4. Personal Interview: Appear for a virtual interview and showcase your motivation for the working executive course with leadership qualities.

Step 5. Fee Submission: Pay the prescribed course fee and finalize your admission.

Step 6. Confirmation: Once the university verifies your details, fee payment, and submitted documents, a "student number" is allotted, and your admission process is completed.
data.placement_content:
The NMIMS online executive MBA is a specially designed online postgraduate degree for working professionals who are currently working and looking for better working opportunities without a career gap. Simultaneously, the students enrolled in this program have an ideal target to enhance their skills and abilities to increase their earning potential and demand fewer employment assistance services.

However, the NMIMS CDOE has provided one-on-one mentorship without any charges under its "Career Development Services" on the alumni portal. It allows enrolled students to build a network and connections with industry professionals and get updated information on job openings.
data.certificate_description: Post-completion of the NMIMS online executive MBA, students are awarded a globally recognized postgraduate degree, demonstrating the dedication of enrolled students towards knowledge and excellence.
data.eligibility_content:
Online Executive MBA Eligibility Criteria

Working professionals willing to upgrade their career without a professional gap can pursue the NMIMS online executive MBA course by fulfilling the below-mentioned eligibility criteria:

  • The applicants must have completed a bachelor's degree in any stream from a recognized university/institution.
  • A minimum of 55% marks at graduation is necessary for general category students. However, a 5% relaxation is awarded to students from SC/ST/OBC/PwD.
  • A valid 3+ years of work experience is essential to pursue this degree program.
  • Students who qualify for the above-mentioned eligibility criterion are required to appear for a personal interview, where they must show their zest, aptitude, and leadership potential.
data.about_content:
The Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies offers a globally recognized professional executive online MBA course under its Centre for Distance and Online Education department. The course is specially crafted for working professionals or executives willing to upskill themselves and foster career development to acquire senior management roles at the helm in diverse business sectors.

The NMIMS online executive MBA course is abbreviated as MBA WX (Working Executives) and offers an in-depth understanding of core business competencies, emphasizing distinctive specializations. The course is delivered in 5 specializations to develop leadership skills and managerial qualities among aspiring global professionals.

The NMIMS online executive MBA is a 2 year postgraduate degree program that enables students to acquire top-tier executive jobs with an immersive learning experience and world-class end-to-end services. The course allows students to opt for a dynamic business environment through the dual specialization facility. The NMIMS online executive MBA provides top-notch learning opportunities with its deep study plan, peer learning, 100% online learning format, and several other personalized student facilities.

reviews.review_text: Being a working professional with 4+ years of experience, enrolling under the NMIMS online EMBA was quite challenging for me, but honestly, it is a completely worth it course for skill development and upliftment.

One of my previous organization's managers told me about the NMIMS online executive MBA for career advancement. I still thank him to date, as now we both are working in the same company, and I got a senior management job role with an 80% hike!
I am totally satisfied with the academic support and education quality offered under the NMIMS online EMBA and highly recommend it to others!!

If you are interested in upskilling without a professional career break, my personal recommendation is the NMIMS online EMBA. It has a perfect balance of every required aspect a working executive asks for. However, consider your preferences too before enrolling, period.

data.syllabus_content:
The NMIMS executive online MBA syllabus covers 8 terms spanning over 2 years with core modules and live lectures. The course curriculum follows an experiential learning approach through a capstone project in term 6 (3 months), a mandatory 6-month hands-on learning industry-based project, and a video/reflective essay at the end of term 8.

The NMIMS online executive MBA follows a 4 quadrant approach by in-house faculty members, which consists of academicians, PhDs, industry veterans, and scholars. For a better course overview, the detailed course syllabus for marketing specialization is mentioned in the table below.

faqs.question: Is an NMIMS executive MBA worth it?
faqs.answer: The NMIMS executive MBA graduates are entitled to the prestigious alumni status of the university with global recognition and provide top-notch education quality with world-class student support services, making the NMIMS executive MBA completely worth it.

faqs.question: Does NMIMS have an executive MBA?
faqs.answer: Yes, NMIMS offers a comprehensive online executive MBA course that is recognized and accepted by global employers.

faqs.question: What is the cost of the NMIMS Executive MBA?
faqs.answer: The total cost of the NMIMS Executive MBA is INR 4,00,000 /-.

faqs.question: What is the drawback of an executive MBA?
faqs.answer: There is no such drawback to an executive MBA. However, students enrolled in the course are obliged to tackle a totally packed schedule that sometimes appears to be hectic.
